cites.quote: startStaleJob(services, clock) calls markStale once at startup and then every hour

findings.text: CO-5/CO-6 have server.ts call startStaleJob(services, clock), but server.ts only gets back an Express app from createApp(pool, config). Services and clock are built inside createApp into app.locals.ctx. The design never says how server.ts gets them.

The glossary has an entry for `Stale` that matches REQ-2.

findings.text: S-6 (REQ-14, glossary entry for Stale) is served by no component. The story map just calls it 'a glossary edit outside the product repo' and names no file, owner or step for it.
